---
title: inif.selectors
description: TokenSelection container; selection methods live on Sample / InifDocument.
reference: inif.selectors
---

The selection container `TokenSelection` is exported from this module.
The actual selection verbs are methods on
[`Sample`](inif.models.qmd) (`.select_by_position`, `.select_by_annotation`,
`.select_by_sequence_id`, `.select_by_span`) and on
[`InifDocument`](inif.models.qmd) (`.filter_samples`, `.filter_samples_by_score`,
`.subset`).

See [Selecting tokens and samples](../concepts/selection.qmd) for the
narrative overview.

## Selection container

### TokenSelection
